  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The bare-name fallback in `map_entry` (`short = name.split("::")[-1]`, `n in (node, short)` / `n.startswith((node + "[", short + "["))`) drops the class qualifier. A listed `tests/path.py::ClassB::test_same` therefore matches the bare name `test_same` of a failing `ClassA::test_same` in the same file and is reported as `reproduced`/`regression` even though it passed.
  WHY: The gate's unittest/script parsers (`workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:146-147,716-717,719-723`) record only bare method names, so heal intake gets false reproduction evidence, which breaks the rule "A test that passes at the failing SHA is never reproduced". Reviewers disagreed on severity: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR, while minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said NIT; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed reachability, because the callers build pairs from extract_failing_tests (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3649, 3685-3688), which drops the class component.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:192-193 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The bare-name fallback in `map_entry` treats any matching bare name as proof that the listed test failed, even when the gate took that name from another test's captured output. `_UNITTEST_RE` accepts `FAIL: <name> (` lines anywhere in the output tail (`workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`, lines 147 and 703-723).
  WHY: If a failing sibling prints a line such as `FAIL: test_x (ClassB)` while the listed `test_x` passes, the gate puts `test_x` in `names` and the passing test is classified `reproduced`/`regression` (source severity NIT).
